senses.gloss:
उज्झ् उज्झ् (a dialect, form of उद्-का), i. 6, Par.
 1. To abandon, Rājat. 5, 349.
 2. To let fall, Kir. 5, 6.
 3. To throw, Rājat. 5, 108.
 उज्झित,
 1. Devoid of, Rājat. 5, 4.
 2. Risked, Rājat. 5, 131.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र,
 1. To abandon, Pañc. v. d. 22.
 2. To avoid, Hit. i. d. 17 n.
 --With सम् सम्, To abandon, Pañc. i. d. 343.
 समुज्झीत, Free from, Prab. 11, 9.
